name: Austin Tiny Puzzles 2023

venue.name: Apartment Clubhouse (Oak Hill, Southwest Austin)
venue.details: To be emailed before the competition

information:
This is a side events only mini-competition, intended to be paired with the Austin location of the [Texas FMC Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasFMCChampionship2023#34618-locations). Please see that competition page for more information, and consider participating in both events.

Note that the round 2 of each event being held is subject to having at least 8 competitors participating in round 1. Information about the exact address in Southwest Austin will be emailed to registered competitors a few days before the event. Due to the size of the venue, non-competing guests will not be permitted except in the case of a minor bringing a parent/guardian.

For a more normal competition experience, check out [Texas Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasChampionship2023).

To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
